about: Coverage exceptions: source strings deliberately or knowingly left untranslated on published locale pages. Each entry names the exact page, kind, source, locales, category (identifier | shared-literal | draft-debt), and rationale. Draft debt is untranslated content still to be translated; a locale with draft debt cannot be classified reviewed.

exceptions.rationale: Twitter/X card type metadata token; a fixed protocol value, not prose.
Open Graph og:type metadata token ("website"); a fixed protocol value, not prose.
Product or company name; family rule keeps Moving Truth and app names unchanged in every language.
